reason: I appreciate the one-time Apple Pay setup with zero auto-renewal, but I'm not paying $3.99 in a normal week for a cram pass when I already use free ChatGPT and NotebookLM. A 'Dual-Model Math Verifier' still sounds like two AIs that can both miss a finance or calculus subscript, and a $3.99 refund doesn't save my grade if I study the wrong formula.
objection: I don't trust AI not to hallucinate finance, econ, or math formulas—two AI models checking each other can still agree on a sign error or misread a messy slide subscript, so I'd still have to check every step myself instead of saving time over free NotebookLM.
would_change_my_mind: Testing the free 5-question preview on my hardest Finance or Calculus past-exam PDF during finals week and seeing every formula and step proven with an actual deterministic math solver rather than just two AIs.
